originalTitle: US stocks today: Dow falls 500 points after Trump says Iran deal is 'over'
simplifiedContent: Here's what happened in the stock market today: the main group of stocks, called the Dow, went down by 500 points. This happened because President Trump said that a deal with Iran is no longer valid, which made people worry about more conflict happening. As a result, the price of oil went up, and this made many stocks go down. However, some stocks related to computer chips, like those made by Apple, actually went up due to a new business deal. This news is important because it shows how world events can affect the stock market and change the value of investments.

originalTitle: US SEC removes legal obstacle to UBS' crisis-resolution plan
simplifiedContent: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has made a decision that helps UBS, a big bank, with its plan for dealing with financial crises. The SEC said it won't take action against UBS if it needs to convert debt into equity (a type of ownership) in an emergency. This decision supports a plan required by Swiss regulators and helps UBS prepare for potential problems. It also helps UBS work better with other countries in case of a crisis. This is important because it makes UBS's plan for dealing with emergencies stronger and more reliable.

originalTitle: Some US Fed officials considered rate hike on Iran war fallout, June meeting minutes reveal
simplifiedContent: The US Federal Reserve (also known as the "Fed") recently met to discuss the country's economy. They talked about inflation, which is the rate at which prices for goods and services are rising, and some officials thought it was a good idea to raise interest rates to control it. However, the Fed decided not to raise interest rates for now, and instead will keep them steady. Some officials are expecting to raise interest rates later this year, which could affect the economy and the stock market. This matters because interest rates can impact how much it costs to borrow money, which can influence the overall health of the economy.

originalTitle: Levi Strauss shares slip ahead of Q2 earnings report as investors await impact of FIFA World Cup campaign
simplifiedContent: Levi Strauss, a well-known clothing company, is about to release its financial report for the second quarter. Before the report comes out, the company's stock price has gone down a bit. Investors are waiting to see how the company did, and they expect Levi Strauss to say it made 24 cents per share in profit and had $1.52 billion in sales. If that happens, it would mean the company's sales and profit grew by about 9% and 8.6% compared to the same time last year. This report is important because it will show whether the company's recent advertising efforts, including a campaign tied to the FIFA World Cup, have been successful.

originalTitle: Laser Power & Infra raises  ₹222 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO
simplifiedContent: Laser Power & Infra Limited is planning to sell its shares to the public through an Initial Public Offering (IPO) that will start on July 9, 2026. Before the IPO, the company has already sold shares to some big investors, called anchor investors, for ₹222 crore at a price of ₹214 per share. The company aims to raise a total of ₹742 crore from its IPO. The shares will be available for different types of investors, including regular individuals, and are expected to start trading on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and National Stock Exchange (NSE) by July 16. This means that soon, anyone can buy and sell shares of Laser Power & Infra Limited on these stock exchanges.

originalTitle: SBI Funds Management files RHP for IPO; issue opens on July 14
simplifiedContent: SBI Funds Management, a company related to State Bank of India, is planning to sell shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means that people can buy shares of the company starting from July 14, 2026. The company is selling up to 203.71 million shares, and State Bank of India is selling some of its own shares in the company, about 128.33 million. This is important because it allows individual investors to buy a part of SBI Funds Management and potentially benefit from its growth. By buying shares, investors can own a small part of the company and may receive returns if the company does well.
